About.intro: BBGeorgiaTech is the technology arm of Bagauri Bonds Georgia. We build websites for small and medium-sized businesses, so customers can find you and reach you easily. We work on only a few projects at a time. We agree on the price and the deadline up front, and if we miss the deadline, we lower the price.

stories.title: Our Approach
stories.text: We believe in technology that is genuinely useful. That’s why we build simple, fast, easy-to-use websites that connect your business with your customers and help you earn their trust.

stories.title: Our Roots
stories.text: Bagauri is our family name, and the responsibility we take on with every project. Once it is paid in full, the website, its code and admin access are entirely yours. We help you grow it, but you always stay in control.

CoreCompetencies.precisionEngineering: Website, sales, Google and care. In one place, at a fixed price.

FAQSection.q1: How much does a new website cost?
FAQSection.a1: The Launch package is {launch} and Business is {business}, or pay monthly from {monthly} for {months} months with the Care plan included. Businesses registered in Georgia pay half of the one-time price. Every project gets a fixed quote within 24 hours of a free consultation; see the Pricing page for every package and add-on.
FAQSection.a2: Yes. Care plans start at {care} a month and cover hosting, SSL, daily backups, security updates and 24/7 monitoring. Care+ adds monthly edits, a report and Google Business updates. Pay yearly and get 2 months free; cancel any time with 30 days' notice.
FAQSection.q3: How long does it take to build a website?
FAQSection.a3: Most business websites go live in about 3 weeks, from the first call to launch: Launch usually takes 2–3 weeks, Business 3–4, and larger custom projects 5–8. Your quote includes the exact launch date.
FAQSection.q4: Do you work with international clients?
FAQSection.a4: Absolutely. We're based in Georgia and work with clients in any country, in English, French or Georgian, by email, WhatsApp or video call.
FAQSection.q5: Can I update my own website after it's built?
FAQSection.a5: Yes. With the Business package you edit texts, photos and prices yourself in a simple editor — no technical knowledge needed — and we record a short walkthrough video for you. On the Launch package, just send us your changes: they're covered by the Care+ plan.

CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.metaDescription: How BBGeorgiaTech uses cookies and browser storage — including Google Analytics — and how to manage or withdraw your consent at any time.
CookiePolicy.p1: We use standard HTTP cookies and browser LocalStorage to improve your experience on our website. A "cookie" is a small text file downloaded onto your device when you visit our site, allowing us to remember your preferences and understand how you use our services.
CookiePolicy.p2: These cookies are essential for the core functionality of our website. You cannot opt-out of these cookies as the site cannot function properly without them.
CookiePolicy.li1Desc: We store a small file in your browser to remember whether you have accepted our cookie banner.
CookiePolicy.li2Desc: We remember your preferred language (e.g., English, French, Georgian) to serve you the correct version of the site.
CookiePolicy.p3: With your consent, we use analytics cookies to measure website performance and understand how visitors interact with our content.
CookiePolicy.li3Desc: Used strictly to measure website loading speed and stability. No personally identifiable information is captured.
CookiePolicy.li4Desc: We use Google Analytics to understand traffic volumes and general geographic locations. Google sets its own cookies to distinguish unique visitors.
CookiePolicy.p4: You have full control over the data you provide to us. To manage your cookie preferences:
CookiePolicy.li5Desc: You can configure your browser to block or alert you about these cookies. Check the "Help" menu of your browser for instructions.
CookiePolicy.li6Desc: To prevent your data from being used by Google Analytics globally, you can install the official
CookiePolicy.li7Desc: You can clear your browser's cache at any time to reset your cookie preferences on our site.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.metaDescription: BBGeorgiaTech's privacy policy: what personal data we collect, how it's used, your GDPR rights, and how to contact us about your data.
PrivacyPolicy.p1: BBGeorgiaTech is committed to safeguarding your privacy. We collect minimal personal data strictly necessary for providing our services. The types of data we collect include:
PrivacyPolicy.li1Desc: Name, email address, and project details voluntarily submitted via our contact form.
PrivacyPolicy.li2Desc: Anonymized usage data collected via Google Analytics and Vercel to monitor website performance and user interaction.
PrivacyPolicy.p2: We process your data based on legitimate business interests and explicit consent. Your contact information is used exclusively to respond to inquiries and discuss your project. Usage data is aggregated to ensure our website remains fast and secure. We never sell, rent, or distribute your data to third parties.
PrivacyPolicy.p3: Contact form submissions are retained on secure mail servers only for the duration necessary to fulfill the inquiry or ongoing project requirements. Anonymized analytics data is retained in accordance with Google Analytics and Vercel data retention policies, typically rolling over after 14 months.
PrivacyPolicy.p4a: Under international data protection laws, including GDPR, you have specific rights regarding your personal information:
PrivacyPolicy.li3Desc: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
PrivacyPolicy.li5Desc: Request the complete deletion of your data from our systems.
PrivacyPolicy.p4b: To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email listed below.
PrivacyPolicy.p5: Our website is hosted on secure global networks. By using our services, you acknowledge that your data may be transferred, processed, and stored across international borders.
PrivacyPolicy.p6: For any inquiries regarding privacy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at:

Terms.pProjects: This section applies when you order a website package or care plan from BBGeorgiaTech. Your written quote or agreement sets out the exact scope, price and launch date; where it differs from this section, the quote or agreement prevails.
proj: Payment: for one-time projects, 50% of the project price is due before work starts and the remaining 50% at launch. All prices are in US dollars (USD).

Local price: businesses registered in Georgia pay 50% of the listed one-time prices for packages and add-ons. Care plans are charged at the listed price. Eligibility is confirmed with the business’s identification code in the quote or agreement.

On-time delivery guarantee: if we miss the agreed launch date for reasons on our side, you receive a 10% discount on the project price for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of 30%. The discount is deducted from the final payment.
The launch date moves accordingly when a delay is caused on your side — for example late content, materials, feedback, approvals or payments — or by changes to the agreed scope.

Partial refund: if you are not satisfied with the design concept after two rounds of revisions, you may end the project before development starts. We then refund 50% of your deposit; the rest covers the design work already done. Once development has started, the deposit is no longer refundable.
Texts: packages include writing the main texts of the website, based on one questionnaire or call with you. You review and approve them before launch.

Monthly payment plan: instead of the 50/50 payment above, the Launch or Business package and the Care plan can be paid in 12 monthly instalments, starting when work begins. The partial refund guarantee does not apply to the monthly payment plan.

You may cancel the monthly payment plan at any time with 30 days’ notice and you owe nothing further. On cancellation, access to the website and to the services built for you ends. Once all instalments are paid, the website belongs to you and you may continue with a care plan or host it yourself.
Ownership: after full payment, the website, its design, its code and admin access belong to you.
Care plans are billed in advance, monthly or yearly (yearly includes 2 months free), and can be cancelled with 30 days’ written notice. Unused hours do not roll over to the next month.
If you cancel a yearly care plan early, we refund the amount paid in proportion to the full months remaining.
Portfolio: BBGeorgiaTech may show the finished website — its name, screenshots and a link — in its portfolio and marketing materials.

scenarios.title: The late-night call
scenarios.text: A pipe bursts in someone’s kitchen. Nobody answers their message on Facebook. They search Google for “plumber near me” and call the first business with a “Call now” button on its website.
scenarios.punch: Your website takes orders even while you sleep.

scenarios.title: “How much?” a hundred times a day
scenarios.text: You answer the same question between clients — by phone, on Instagram, on WhatsApp. On a website, your services, prices and hours are written once.
scenarios.punch: Fewer messages, more time for the work.

scenarios.title: The visitor who can’t read your language
scenarios.text: A tourist or expat looks for the best place in town. Your Instagram is in one language; your competitor’s website is in three.
scenarios.punch: Your site speaks your language — and your client’s.

scenarios.title: Instagram isn’t yours
scenarios.text: Algorithms change, accounts get blocked, fewer people see each post. Your website and domain belong to you — and a business with a website simply looks more serious.
scenarios.punch: Social media introduces you. A website earns trust.

scenarios.title: A question to ChatGPT

meta.title: Websites for Trades & Home Services | BBGeorgiaTech
meta.description: Websites for trades and local services: call buttons, quote forms, project galleries and local SEO. Texts included, from {price}.

homeServices.name: Home Services & Trades

hero.subtitle: For renovation companies, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, movers and other local service businesses. A fast site that shows your work, earns trust and turns visitors into quote requests.

problems.title: Clients can't find you on Google
problems.text: People search “plumber near me” and call whoever shows up first. Without a website and a Google Business Profile, that isn't you.

problems.title: Your best work is hidden in your phone
problems.text: Photos of finished jobs sit in your gallery or on Facebook, where new clients never see them.

problems.title: Calls and quote requests get lost
problems.text: Requests arrive through WhatsApp, Messenger and missed calls, with no clear way for clients to ask for a quote.

call.title: One-tap call & WhatsApp
call.text: Big buttons on every page, so mobile visitors reach you in a second.

quote.title: Quote request form
quote.text: Clients describe the job, add photos and their address — you get everything in one email.

gallery.title: Before / after gallery
gallery.text: Finished projects, organized by service, prove the quality of your work.

local.title: Local SEO
local.text: Pages for your services and areas plus Google Business Profile setup, so you show up in local searches and on Maps.

trust.title: Reviews & guarantees
trust.text: Reviews, licenses, warranties and years of experience, shown exactly where clients decide.

languages.title: Several languages
languages.text: Reach expats, tourists and international clients in their own language.

homeServices.recommend: Most trades businesses need the Launch package: a fast site with call buttons, a project gallery and Google Business setup. Choose the Business package if you want a multi-step quote form, several languages and to update your gallery yourself.

faq.q: How fast can my site be live?
faq.a: A Launch site usually goes live in 2–3 weeks. We write the texts; you send your logo and photos of your work.

faq.q: Can I add new project photos myself?
faq.a: Yes. With the Business package you can upload photos to your gallery straight from your phone, without any technical skills.

faq.q: Will it help me show up on Google Maps?
faq.a: We set up and optimize your Google Business Profile and build local SEO into the site. Rankings depend on competition and reviews, so we don't promise positions — but the foundation will be done right.

faq.q: I already have a Facebook page. Why do I need a website?
faq.a: Facebook doesn't rank in Google the way a website does, and clients can't easily find your services, prices and past work there. A website is yours and works for you around the clock.
